question: Newsletter's undo: how many top-bar Undo presses each panel change takes, and the rows it gives back. Predicted before the read, from ours as built in #426 (one step per field edit once the field is left, one per switch or pick, the rows as they were before the step).
how: A new Newsletter on the probe page at 10 columns by 8 rows, Edit, Content. Each step below by real presses and keys; a field is left with blur before an Undo. Rows read from the block's grid area.

steps.do: Title: Cmd+A, Backspace, keys H i; leave the field

other.rule: undo refits the rows to the content

steps.do: Show Name Field on (rows 14), then Undo once
Design: Layout Stack (rows 9), then Undo once
Content: Disclaimer emptied and left (rows 6); Button Text Cmd+A, Backspace, G o, left
